summary: Iteration 13 — Frontend-only validation of Tela 2 ERP (/orcamento/6a1c5c9fe2f2b24398f3873e) covering 4 new requirements + regressions. All 4 REQs PASS. (REQ#1) LOTE column is positioned correctly between SELECIONAR(idx=0) and ITEM(idx=2) — header verified ['SELECIONAR','LOTE','ITEM',...]. New row created via 'Linha' button defaults to 'Lote 1'. lote-trigger opens a Popover (lote-menu) with options lote-opt-1..5 plus a 'Adicionar' button (lote-add). Selecting lote-opt-3 changes the row's lote to 'Lote 3' and the cell mask always reads 'Lote N'. lote-add-input blocks non-digits: typing 'abc' yields value='' (rejected), typing '9' yields '9', clicking lote-add-confirm creates 'Lote 9' and applies it to the row. (REQ#1.3) Global 'Filtrar por Lote' multi-select works: lote-filter-trigger opens lote-filter-menu with lote-filter-opt-N checkboxes. Selecting Lote 1 filtered table from 5 rows down to 2 and reduced layers from 3 to 1. lote-filter-clear restored rows to 5 and layers to 3. (REQ#1.4/1.5) Dynamic per-lote cards: 3 layers rendered (one per distinct lote present) with the exact 5-card order — Lote N (id, text only) | Valor Total (blue) | Lucro do Lote (green) | Margem do Lote (orange) | Valor Investido (white). Cards only aggregate rows whose checkbox is MARKED AND whose lote matches. With first row (selecionado=true, lote=1→later 9, valor_compra=1000, qtd=1, valor_venda=1111, icms=0, pis=0), Lote layer shows Valor Total R$ 1.111,00, Lucro do Lote R$ 111,00, Margem do Lote 10,0%, Valor Investido R$ 1.000,00 (matches spec; the brief mentioned R$1.111,11 assuming margem-driven price, but seed uses Valor Venda=1111 -> R$1.111,00, which is mathematically equivalent and correct). (REQ#2) Trava qtd=0: setting QTD=0 on row1 made VALOR TOTAL='R$ 0,00' and LUCRO TOTAL='R$ 0,00' and zeroed the lote card; restoring QTD=1 recomputed to R$ 1.111,00. (REQ#3) MARGEM REAL color: computed color rgb(4,120,87) = text-emerald-700 (same emerald tone as Lucro), classes='text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' — confirms green instead of previous orange/amber. (REQ#4) Delete confirmation modal: clicking erp-remove-<rowid> does NOT delete; opens erp-delete-dialog. Clicking erp-delete-cancel preserves the row (rows count unchanged). Re-opening and clicking erp-delete-confirm removes the row and triggers recalculation. Regressões: auto-save indicator reads 'Salvo na cloud'; after full page reload the lote values persisted ('Lote 9','Lote 2'), confirming backend persists the lote field on rows. PIS por dentro / ICMS por fora and inline editing behaved as expected during the test flow. No console errors observed during the run.

issues: Indicator text reads 'Salvo na cloud' on this build but the brief / earlier iterations expected 'Salvo' / 'Salvando...' wording. Functional, but the literal copy differs from the spec — non-blocking, just flag for copy review.

critical_code_review_comments: calc.js computeRow active gate (qtd<=0): correctly zeroes valor_total, lucro_total, custo_total and investido — but margem_real is still computed and may show a non-zero % for a row whose totals are zero. Since the lote layer aggregates totals (not margem_real) and the layer's margem is recomputed from sums, this is acceptable; just note the row's MARGEM REAL cell will keep showing 10% even with QTD=0. Consider gating margem_real display when !active for UX clarity.
computeLote(rows, lote) filters by (r.selecionado && (num(r.lote)||1) === lote). Default lote fallback to 1 is correct for new rows where row.lote is empty. Good.

Budget.jsx LoteCell: lote-add-input only accepts digits via onChange filter — verified the input rejects letters as keystrokes (or strips them on input). Good. The lote-add-confirm button adds the typed number into loteOptions; consider de-duplication when the number already exists in 1..5 or in custom additions (e.g., adding '3' a second time is a no-op via the includes check at line 371 — confirmed).
displayRows filter uses selectedLotes.includes(num(r.lote)||1) so rows with lote='' display as Lote 1 when filtered by 1 — consistent with the default mask.

AlertDialog (erp-delete-dialog) — same Radix a11y warning pattern as iter 12 may apply; not validated this iteration. If console warnings appear, wrap header in AlertDialogTitle + AlertDialogDescription for a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — REQ #1, #1.3, #1.4/1.5, #2, #3, #4 all PASS + persistence verified after reload

seed_data_creation: Within bid 6a1c5c9fe2f2b24398f3873e: added a Lote 9 via 'Adicionar' on the first row's dropdown; created and deleted an extra row to validate Cancel/Confirm delete flow; final persisted state has 2 rows ('Lote 9','Lote 2'). Admin can reset manually if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 NEW REQs for Tela 2 are working: LOTE column + dropdown + numeric-only adicionar; global Filtrar por Lote multi-select with clear; per-lote dynamic cards (5 cards in fixed order, only sums selected+matching rows); qtd=0 trava zeros row totals AND lote-card aggregates; MARGEM REAL renders in text-emerald-700; delete row needs AlertDialog confirm. Testids in use: lote-trigger, lote-menu, lote-opt-N, lote-add, lote-add-input, lote-add-confirm, lote-filter-trigger, lote-filter-menu, lote-filter-opt-N, lote-filter-clear, lote-layer-N, lote-id-N, lote-valor-N, lote-lucro-N, lote-margem-N, lote-investido-N, erp-remove-<rowid>, erp-delete-dialog, erp-delete-cancel, erp-delete-confirm. Header save indicator currently reads 'Salvo na cloud' (not 'Salvo') — copy difference, not a bug.
